title: Hugging Face Fine-Tuning Lab
description: Production-focused Hugging Face NLP fine-tuning workbench with reproducible training, robust evaluation, PEFT/LoRA support, batch inference, FastAPI serving, and model-card/report generation.
notes: Source code archive for the Hugging Face Fine-Tuning Lab v1.0.1 release. The repository includes reproducible training pipelines, evaluation utilities, governance artifacts, notebooks, tests, and serving examples for NLP fine-tuning workflows.
method: The software is distributed as a Poetry-managed Python package. Reproducible workflows are documented in the repository notebooks and docs, with quality gates provided by ruff, mypy, pytest, and the GitHub Actions release workflow.
